chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn Idris, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar. He said: Al-Sadiq Jafar ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, said:
The body does not weaken from that which the intention has strengthened it for.

key_terms.النية: niyyah — intention or resolve; a foundational concept in Islam where the sincerity and strength of one's inner determination shapes one's actions and their outcomes
key_terms.بدن: body; the physical form which, according to this hadith, is subordinate to the power of intention

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about the relationship between intention (niyyah) and bodily strength in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam Jafar al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that when a person has strong resolve and sincere intention (niyyah), the body will not fail to carry out the task. This teaching, delivered during a session recorded on Friday the 26th of Rabi al-Awwal 368 AH, emphasizes the Islamic principle that spiritual willpower directly empowers physical capability.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad b. Idris (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. al-Faddal from al-Hasan b. al-Jahm from al-Fudayl b. Yasar. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:
The body does not weaken if one strengthens it with his intention.
